youtube_description:
I'm about to start a new season of camping at Larps, and something that I always do is check my gear. Of course, it applies to everything, but one of my favourite moments is when I put my tent up to confirm everything is A-OK.

This video is all about that moment, the personal ritual which makes you feel relaxed and ready for the coming months.

From a purely practical viewpoint, just making sure you are ready is always good.

The tent in question is a Quecha 4.1 XL  Air Seconds. Stuart reviewed these a while ago, and mine is a slightly updated model from his. You can see that original review via this link:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tNOmWfgcc8Y

His tent has performed admirably, and I'd like to add to that review by stating that these are excellent practical tents. Easy to put up and takedown. The interior space works well, and there a plenty of nice little touches which make this a tent you smile at when using.
youtube_title: Check Your Tent Before the Start of the Season
